description.value: A branch of the Greater Victoria Public Library, located in Langford. The library offers free public computer access, Wi-Fi, and a wide digital collection including ebooks, audiobooks, and streaming media. A useful rest stop for touring cyclists passing through the western communities of Greater Victoria.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack at 69m; rack at 70m; rack at 70m; rack at 71m.
